adk1.review:
BEN205 - AdK1 (Dr. Anirudha Kahaly) - RA 1st and 3rd slot
Sir teaches well. He takes two quizzes and counts the best one and there is only one mid. There is a report writing, and different topics are assigned to individuals. You also need to deliver a Bangla presentation on the same topic. He takes a viva worth five marks and will notify about the topics earlier. All the exams are very easy. However, I found his marking to be a bit stringent for the literature section. Lastly, try to participate in his class, and your grades will be curved.
